hooks.name: Auto-commit after task

action.prompt: Run pnpm -r typecheck and pnpm -r test (checks every package). If both pass, git add the changed files (never .env or secrets) and commit with the message "Spec 02 task <number>: <task title>". Do not push. If anything fails, do not commit; fix it first.

hooks.description: Typecheck and test every package (pnpm -r), then commit after each spec task
